mapper.select: SELECT a.biz01_promo_id AS promo_id , COALESCE(a.biz01_close_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS close_yn , CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.biz01_close_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '마감' ELSE '' END AS close_name , crd01_card_nm AS html_card_name , b.crd02_approval_dt AS approval_dt , b.crd02_franchise_nm AS franchise_name , b.crd02_sector_nm AS sector_name , b.crd02_approval_amount AS approval_amount , a.biz01_provide_pur_cd AS provide_pur_code , f_cdnm('ProvidePurCode', a.biz01_provide_pur_cd, a.biz01_company_id, a.biz01_provide_date) AS provide_pur_name , a.biz01_provide_content_cd AS provide_content_code , f_cdnm('ProvideContentCode', a.biz01_provide_content_cd, a.biz01_company_id, a.biz01_provide_date) AS provide_content_name , a.biz01_account_code_id AS account_code_id , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END||d.act01_account_nm AS account_name , c.biz02_count AS total_peple , TRUNC(a.biz01_provide_amt / (CASE WHEN a.biz01_provide_rcv_type = '2' THEN f_nvl(c.biz02_emp_count,1) ELSE f_nvl(c.biz02_count ,1) END)) AS average_price , a.biz01_note AS note FROM biz01_promo a INNER JOIN crd01_card ON crd01_card_id = biz01_card_id INNER JOIN crd02_data b ON crd02_data_id = a.biz01_card_data_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = biz01_company_id LEFT OUTER JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS biz02_count , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(biz02_emp_yn,'false') = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS biz02_emp_count FROM biz02_person WHERE biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id ) c ON TRUE LEFT OUTER JOIN act01_account_code d ON d.act01_account_code_id = a.biz01_account_code_id WHERE 1=1 AND biz01_company_id = #{companyId} AND ( (sys01_card_real_user_yn = 'true' AND biz01_real_person_id = #{personId}) OR ( (sys01_card_real_user_yn IS DISTINCT FROM 'true') AND #{personId} IN ( SELECT crd03_person_id FROM crd03_trans INNER JOIN crd01_card ON crd01_card_id = crd03_card_id WHERE a.biz01_provide_date BETWEEN crd03_fr_dt AND COALESCE(crd03_to_dt,to_date('29991231','yyyyMMdd')) AND a.biz01_card_id = crd03_card_id ) ) ) AND biz01_provide_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND CONCAT(crd01_card_nm,crd02_franchise_nm,crd02_sector_nm, biz01_note) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY biz01_provide_date

SELECT act01_account_code_id AS account_code_id , act01_account_cd AS account_code , CASE WHEN COALESCE(act01_use_yn,'false') = 'false' THEN '(사용X)' ELSE '' END||act01_account_nm AS account_name FROM act14_link INNER JOIN act01_account_code ON ( act01_company_id = act14_company_id AND act01_account_cd = act14_account_cd ) WHERE act14_company_id = #{companyId} AND act14_provide_content_cd = #{provideContentCode} ORDER BY COALESCE(act14_seq, act14_account_cd::numeric)

SELECT a.dcr01_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(a.dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_full_name FROM dcr01_class_tree a , dcr30_link b WHERE dcr01_company_id = #{companyId} AND dcr30_class_tree_id = dcr01_class_tree_id AND dcr30_link_cd = #{linkCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_string02, sys99_date01, sys99_string03, sys99_string04, sys99_long01 , sys99_string05, sys99_string06, sys99_long02, sys99_long03, sys99_string07 ) VALUES ( #{printId}, #{companyId}, #{personId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , COALESCE(#{row.htmlCardName}, ''), #{row.approvalDt}, COALESCE(#{row.franchiseName}, ''), COALESCE(#{row.sectorName}, ''), COALESCE(#{row.approvalAmount}, 0) , COALESCE(#{row.providePurName}, ''), COALESCE(#{row.provideContentName}, ''), COALESCE(#{row.totalPeple}, 0), COALESCE(#{row.averagePrice}, 0), COALESCE(#{row.note}, '') )
